# opstracer_observability_connection (Resource)

A connection to an observability provider (Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, New Relic, CloudWatch, GCP) that OpsTracer reads telemetry from. The API checks the credentials against the provider when the connection is created. Which services use a connection is managed with `opstracer_service_data_sources`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "grafana_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "opstracer_observability_connection" "grafana" {
  type  = "grafana"
  name  = "grafana-prod"
  site  = "https://acme.grafana.net"
  token = var.grafana_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Provider: `datadog`, `grafana`, `sentry`, `newrelic`, `cloudwatch` or `gcp`. Railway connects through OAuth and is not supported here.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID, used instead of `role_arn` (CloudWatch). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `account_id` (String) Account ID (New Relic). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key (Datadog, New Relic). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `application_key` (String, Sensitive) Application key (Datadog). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `env_label` (String) Label that holds the environment name. Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `name` (String) Connection name. Defaults to the provider's display name, e.g. `Grafana`.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug (Sentry). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN to assume (CloudWatch). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key, used with `access_key_id` (CloudWatch). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `service_account_key` (String, Sensitive) Service account key JSON (GCP). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.
- `site` (String) Provider site or address, e.g. `datadoghq.eu`, a Grafana stack URL, or an AWS region. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (Grafana, Sentry). Never returned by the API; changing it replaces the connection. After an import the configured value is adopted in place.

### Read-Only

- `credential_hints` (Map of String) Last characters of each stored credential.
- `id` (String) Connection ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the org's default connection for its provider. The first connection of a provider becomes the default.
- `settings` (Map of String) Provider settings the API applied, such as the labels it reads environment and service from.
- `status` (String) Connection status reported by the API, e.g. `active`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Credentials are never returned; set them in config and expect a replacement unless they match the original.
terraform import opstracer_observability_connection.grafana <connection-id>
```
